_comment: Copy to pinterest_secrets.json (gitignored) and fill in. Register an app at https://developers.pinterest.com/apps/ to get app_id (client_id) + app_secret (client_secret). redirect_uri must exactly match the app config (https). New apps start in TRIAL access, which can create pins on YOUR OWN account.
_api_base_comment: Production is https://api.pinterest.com . While your app is in TRIAL access, pins/boards are sandbox-only (private to you) and you should use https://api-sandbox.pinterest.com . Switch to production after you're granted Standard access.
_board_comment: Pins are posted to a board matched by name (created if missing). privacy SECRET keeps them private until you make the board public — the safe default. pins.csv's suggested_board overrides default_name per pin.

board.description: Personalized Islamic name prints — Arabic calligraphy wall art.
